role: The Watch target's composition root, in the shape of the phone's AppDependencies (which the Watch target does not compile): the one Watch file that reads `.shared`, returning the session manager and strap connector, or a substitute set on the container's overrides.
types: WatchDependencies: struct (main-actor by the target's default isolation) — the Watch container
WatchDependencies.Overrides: final class — optional substitutes for sessionManager and strapConnector
state: mem:WatchDependencies.current (static var, the container in force; the app never assigns it)
mem:WatchDependencies.overrides (let, one Overrides box per container)
toplevel: Declares the container, its static `current` (initialised to a fresh WatchDependencies on first access) and the Overrides class whose two optional properties start nil. Read by WatchApp's stored-property initializers and init, and by WatchAppDelegate.handleActiveWorkoutRecovery (same file) for a recovery relaunch before any view. Enforced as the Watch root by scripts/check_no_shared_outside_root.sh.

units.does: Returns overrides.sessionManager when set, otherwise WatchSessionManager.shared (whose first access runs WatchSessionManager.init, activating WCSession).
units.entry: Read by WatchApp's sessionManager @StateObject initializer and WatchApp.init.

units.does: Returns overrides.strapConnector when set, otherwise WatchStrapConnector.shared (first access runs WatchStrapConnector.init).
units.entry: Read by WatchApp's strapConnector @StateObject initializer and WatchApp.init.
